people.name: Ahaz
people.line: King of Judah, son of Jotham

people.name: Damascus
people.line: Ancient city, capital of Syria, important in biblical history.

people.name: Uriah
people.line: Priest during the reign of King Ahaz

translations.web: Urijah the priest built an altar. According to all that king Ahaz had sent from Damascus, so Urijah the priest made it for the coming of king Ahaz from Damascus.
translations.bsb: And Uriah the priest built the altar according to all the instructions King Ahaz had sent from Damascus, and he completed it before King Ahaz returned.
translations.kjv: And Urijah the priest built an altar according to all that king Ahaz had sent from Damascus: so Urijah the priest made it against king Ahaz came from Damascus.
translations.asv: And Urijah the priest built an altar: according to all that king Ahaz had sent from Damascus, so did Urijah the priest make it against the coming of king Ahaz from Damascus.
